external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: One of three insurance partners that provides a daily extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: Represents the three insurance partners collectively.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: An analyst who queries the warehouse directly.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler running in the landing network that wakes at 02:00, lists the landing bucket, reads files, and triggers a Spark transform job.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A Spark job in the warehouse network that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket where insurance partners place daily claim-record extracts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The extracts contain claim records with member names and dates of birth. I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted. Both are on defaults as far as I know.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow's metadata database, containing connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: I don't know whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest. Both are on defaults as far as I know.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse where the normalized claim records are loaded and queried by analysts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_stores.notes: The grant is dataset-wide; member-identifying columns have not been split out.

data_flows.name: daily extract
data_flows.description: An insurance partner pushes a daily extract into the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.notes: Each partner has a static key issued at onboarding; the keys have not changed since.
data_flows.data_description: Claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: list and read
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler lists the landing bucket and reads the files in it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
data_flows.notes: The scheduler does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

data_flows.name: stores configuration
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler stores connection strings and partner keys in the Airflow metadata database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_flows.name: triggers job
data_flows.description: For each file, the Airflow scheduler triggers a Spark transform job.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
data_flows.data_description: A file containing claim records for processing.

data_flows.name: loads records
data_flows.description: The Spark transform job normalizes claim records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.
data_flows.data_description: Normalized claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: queries warehouse
data_flows.notes: Analysts authenticate with SSO, but the grant is dataset-wide and member-identifying columns have not been split out.
data_flows.data_description: Warehouse claim records, including member-identifying columns.

trust_boundaries.name: insurance partners
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the external insurance partners that provide the extracts.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.

trust_boundaries.name: landing network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the Airflow scheduler and landing bucket.

assumptions.assumption: The three insurance partners are represented as one external-system entity because the description does not distinguish them by name.
assumptions.basis: The source describes insurance partners as external parties that push files to us, but provides no individual partner names.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow scheduler presents a non-web interface because it is described as a scheduler in a nightly batch data pipeline.
assumptions.basis: The source describes a nightly scheduler that lists a bucket, reads files, and triggers a job rather than a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The Spark transform job presents a non-web interface because it is described as a batch transform job.
assumptions.basis: The source describes a Spark transform job processing files and loading records rather than a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The source says the extracts contain claim records with member names and dates of birth.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow metadata database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The source says it contains connection strings and partner keys.
The source says normalized claim records are loaded into BigQuery, and the source identifies those records as containing member names and dates of birth.
